visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with styled brown hair wearing a black pleated blazer is seated behind a wooden desk in a brightly lit indoor space. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing actively with his hands to emphasize his points. Behind him, a blurred yellow sofa and indoor plants are visible. Sudden graphic overlays appear on screen, including a crinkled black plastic texture, a blue sky filled with hot air balloons, and a green chameleon, each appearing momentarily over the man's figure. (2) The scene shifts to extreme close-ups of dark, metallic granular materials and cut-out geometric metal shapes resting on them. Then, two hands enter the frame holding two different colored insulated tumblers—one a gradient blue-purple and the other an orange-pink. The background shows a neutral-toned wall and stone surface. (3) A sequence of fast cuts shows the blue tumbler hanging from a bag strap against a concrete wall, then tea being poured from a glass pot into the tumbler. The man is shown in a small inset or cutaway, continuing his gestures. A row of five tumblers in various metallic shades (gold, green, silver, blue, purple) is displayed against an outdoor leafy background. (4) The man returns to the full frame, speaking with high energy. Cut to a silver tumbler resting on a brown leather chair, followed by shots of tumblers mounted on a white scooter. Large white and red text overlays dominate the screen during these product shots. (5) The final phase shows a hand pulling a blue tumbler out of a leather bag. Two tumblers, one cream-white and one black, are placed on a bright blue tennis court surface. The man concludes by gesturing with open palms, and various text blocks with prices and codes appear in yellow and white boxes at the bottom and center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator delivering a series of rapid-fire questions. His voice is clear, with a bright spectral quality and animated intonation. A steady, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse supports the speech. Every time a visual overlay appears, a sharp 'whoosh' or 'pop' transition SFX punctuates the audio track. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound triggers a shift as the narrator continues explaining the properties of titanium. The sound of liquid splashing into a container and a crisp metallic click of a lid closing are layered over the BGM. The music maintains a constant 124 BPM, providing a driving energy. (3) The narration becomes more detailed and descriptive. A bright 'ding' SFX sounds to emphasize specific features mentioned, such as 'SGS certification.' The BGM remains in a major key, contributing to a positive and reliable mood. (4) A brief acoustic discontinuity occurs at the 49-second mark with a comedic slide-whistle or 'boing' sound effect, accompanying a brief blooper-style vocal inflection before the narrator quickly regains his professional, persuasive tone for the final call to action. (5) The final phase features a crescendo in vocal intensity and arousal as the narrator provides pricing and discount information. The track concludes with a final synthesized chime sound that lingers slightly as the voice fades out.
